papers.title_en: CytoWave: Perturbation-Centric Pretraining for Single-Cell Response Prediction
papers.authors: Yuwei Miao, Jingquan Yan, Hehuan Ma, Thao M. Dang, Lin Xu, Siyuan Zhang, Junzhou Huang
papers.evidence: 以扰动为中心的单细胞扰动响应预训练
papers.tldr: 单细胞扰动响应预测对基因功能与药物设计重要，但现有方法受实验方案、生物背景和物种差异影响，跨数据集泛化困难。CytoWave以扰动为中心，先利用同源基因统一跨物种大规模扰动数据，通过两阶段预训练学习对照细胞状态并预测扰动后表达，同时用对比目标对齐扰动响应与扰动信号。严格留出数据集评估和多条件组合、通路活性案例显示其预测稳定有效，为跨数据集单细胞扰动响应建模提供了可泛化框架。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting gene expression under perturbations from single-cell data is a fundamental task for modeling cellular responses, with applications in discovering gene function and designing therapeutics. However, existing methods often struggle to generalize across datasets due to differences in experimental protocols, biological contexts, and species. We present \textbf{CytoWave}, a perturbation-centric pretraining framework for single-cell genetic perturbation response prediction. We leverage large-scale cross-species perturbation datasets unified via orthology and train CytoWave in a two-stage manner. In the first stage, we learn reference control cell states via masked gene expression recovery on unperturbed cells. In the second stage, we pretrain the model to predict perturbed gene expression given control states and perturbation signals, together with a contrastive objective that aligns latent representations of perturbation responses with perturbation signals. We perform strict dataset-held-out evaluation across multiple condition combinations and case studies of pathway activity changes, demonstrating consistent and effective performance of CytoWave in predicting single-cell genetic perturbation responses.

papers.title_en: A low-rank decoder bottleneck bounds reliability in foundation-model perturbation prediction
papers.authors: Zheyu Zhang, Yuanhao Huang, Fan Feng, Jie Liu
papers.evidence: 审计STATE、scGPT等基础模型扰动预测的可靠性
papers.tldr: 基础模型扰动预测多以总体精度评估，难以判断单条预测能否用于实验排序。作者审计STATE状态转移解码器，覆盖三种编码器与四种CRISPRi细胞系，发现首层注意力输出低秩。将输出投影到4–32个训练激活方向仍保留平均PDC，且PDC随预测响应到最近训练响应的余弦距离增大而下降。据此提出predicted-NN-distance置信度，该分数与PDC的平均绝对Spearman相关为0.81，阈值可跨编码器和细胞系迁移，并初步适用于药物扰动。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model predictors of perturbation response are evaluated primarily by aggregate accuracy. Using their predictions to prioritize experiments requires assessing each prediction's reliability. We audit the state-transition (ST) decoder used in STATE across three encoders (SE-600M, scGPT, and Tahoe-x1) and four cell lines under CRISPRi. The decoder's first attention layer has a low-rank output. Projecting this output onto 4-32 fixed directions estimated from training activations preserves mean per-perturbation Pearson delta correlation (PDC). This low-rank attention bottleneck bounds the decoder's reliability by distance to training responses: PDC declines as the cosine distance from a perturbation's observed response to its nearest training response increases. We propose predicted-NN-distance, the cosine distance from a predicted response to its nearest training response, as a per-prediction confidence score. The score has a mean absolute Spearman correlation of 0.81 with PDC, close to the 0.88 obtained with the observed response. Thresholds calibrated on this score transfer across encoders and cell lines, and the score remains predictive of PDC for drug perturbations.

papers.title_en: CellCanon: An Agentic Cellular World Model for Prediction, Explanation, and Observation-Driven Updating
papers.authors: Zhaokang Liang, Shuyang Zhuang, Xiaoran Jiao, Hao Chen
papers.evidence: 预测超出已观测条件的单细胞表达的细胞世界模型
papers.tldr: 生物发现需借助分子知识与新测量推断未观测的细胞响应。CellCanon作为首个智能体细胞世界模型，统一单细胞表达预测、证据解释和观测驱动更新，并复用条件级证据指导基因特异性表达生成。在339个SciPlex3留出条件上，差异表达AUPRC和Macro-F1较最佳基线提升63.3%和17.3%，方向Macro-F1提升7.2%。该工作用共享世界状态连接预测、测量与来源声明，支持证据累积下可修订的细胞响应判断。
papers.abstract_en: Biological discovery requires using molecular knowledge and new measurements to infer responses beyond the conditions already observed. We introduce CellCanon, the first agentic cellular world model to unify single-cell expression prediction, evidence-grounded explanation, and observation-driven updating. Its predictive core reuses condition-level biological evidence across gene-specific numerical readouts to guide single-cell expression generation. A shared world state links predictions, acquired measurements, and source-linked claims, supporting explanation and revision. On 339 held-out SciPlex3 conditions across three cell lines, CellCanon improves differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 over the best baseline for each metric by 63.3% and 17.3%, respectively, and direction Macro-F1 by 7.2%. Relative to gene-wise reasoning on matched drug-cell cohorts, measured language-model token use falls by 99.77% for Predict and 98.41% for Explain. On the source-grounded benchmark, Explain correctly answers all answerable questions with supporting proofs and identifies all insufficient-evidence cases. In simulated experimental feedback, Update uses one measured source context per drug to exceed the best fine-tuned baselines in differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 without changing model weights. Together, these capabilities support a cumulative account of cellular responses, with predictions and biological judgments that can be revised as evidence accumulates.

papers.title_en: scAnyOmics: Foundation-Model Distillation for Any-to-Any Completion of Multi-omics Virtual Cells
papers.authors: Zhaoqi Song, Ye Du, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Qian Niu
papers.evidence: 将冻结的单细胞基础模型蒸馏为多模态虚拟细胞学生模型
papers.tldr: 单细胞多组学可刻画转录组、蛋白与染色质状态，但异质模态整合和缺失分子预测仍受配对数据有限制约。scAnyOmics将冻结的单细胞基础模型知识蒸馏到多模态学生模型，把scRNA-seq、蛋白标记和scATAC-seq映射到共享表示，实现任意到任意的跨模态补全与重建。在六项研究共690,880个细胞及留出供体上，其表现优于基线。该框架还支持细胞注释、扰动响应预测和生物年龄估计，为虚拟细胞建模提供统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in single-cell technologies have enabled the profiling of multiple molecular modalities, including transcriptomics, proteomics, and chromatin accessibility, providing a more comprehensive understanding of cellular states. However, integrating heterogeneous modalities and predicting missing molecular information remain challenging, particularly when paired measurements are limited. Here, we introduce scAnyOmics, a generative framework that distills knowledge from a frozen single-cell foundation model into a multimodal student model. scAnyOmics integrates scRNA-seq, protein-marker measurements, and scATAC-seq into a shared representation, enabling cross-modal prediction and reconstruction of missing modalities. We assembled 690,880 cells from six publicly available studies, covering both paired and partially paired multi-omics measurements, to systematically evaluate its predictive performance. We further evaluated scAnyOmics on held-out donor data, where it outperformed baseline methods across multiple evaluation metrics. Beyond cross-modal reconstruction, we explored its applications in cell-type annotation, perturbation-response prediction, and biological age estimation. Overall, scAnyOmics provides a unified framework for integrating incomplete single-cell multi-omics data and transferring pretrained biological knowledge, supporting the development of virtual cell models across diverse cellular contexts and experimental platforms.

papers.title_en: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
papers.authors: Farnoush Rezaei Jafari, Tristan Lazard, Kenza Bouzid, Shruthi Bannur, Jeremiah Wander, Ashley Mae Conard, Stephanie Hyland, Lorin Crawford, Daniel Coelho de Castro
papers.evidence: 针对单细胞基础模型扰动预测的归因诊断
papers.tldr: 单细胞基础模型预测性能好，但难以判断其依赖生物学信号还是模型捷径。作者系统评估下游预测的事后归因，覆盖Cell2Sentence/scGPT细胞类型注释与scGPT+STATE扰动预测。归因揭示标记基因使用、上下文交互、输入通路贡献及学习进程，并显示结论高度依赖生物参考、基线和零模型选择。该工作将归因定位为理解与诊断scFM的灵活工具。
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

papers.title_en: Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context
papers.authors: Gokul Gowri, Nic Fishman, William N. Colgan, Minming Wang, Yusuke Kijima, Sachin A. Kumar, Aleksandr Zimin, Luke W. Koblan, Marinka Zitnik, Zachary D. Smith, Stephen Bates, Philippe Rigollet, Jonathan S. Weissman
papers.evidence: 建模细胞状态动态并生成扰动响应假设
papers.tldr: 多细胞系统的动力学预测是生物学的核心目标，而谱系上下文（姐妹细胞、表亲细胞等的状态）有望为此提供关键信息，但如何有效利用尚不明确。作者提出“谱系修补”（lineage inpainting），结合树结构Transformer与随机插值（stochastic interpolants），在谱系树上生成式建模细胞状态动态。在小鼠胚胎发生的谱系追踪转录组图谱上，该方法恢复了仅靠基因表达无法解析的动态，包括多条谱系汇聚到共同状态的转录收敛事件。该工作表明谱系信息为学习多细胞动力学提供了丰富的上下文来源。
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of biology is to predict the dynamics of multicellular systems. Lineage context (the states of a cell's sisters, cousins, etc.) could inform these predictions, but how best to leverage it remains unclear. Here we introduce lineage inpainting, a generative modeling approach that uses lineage context with tree-structured transformers and stochastic interpolants to model cell state dynamics across lineage trees. Applied to a lineage-traced transcriptional atlas of mouse embryogenesis, it recovers dynamics not resolved by gene expression alone, including multiple transcriptional convergence events where distinct lineages are drawn to a common state. Despite being fit on unperturbed development, lineage inpainting can generate hypotheses about perturbation responses by simulating counterfactuals. These simulations agree in many cases with observed developmental phenotypes, including a single-cell measurement of the Tbx5 knockout response. Our results show that lineage information provides a rich source of context for learning multicellular dynamics.

papers.title_en: Cell lines that share a well are not independent observations in the Tahoe-100M drug screen
papers.evidence: 药物扰动响应预测基准的统计独立性检验
papers.tldr: Tahoe-100M等混合药物筛选将多个细胞系同孔处理，但现有基准与统计检验把同孔细胞系及同孔随机半样本视为独立观测。作者用13块板的未处理对照孔、经标签核验的重复孔和逐孔重复的两块板，检验同孔共享表达能否被重复孔复现。结果发现同孔效应显著：重复孔无法复现同孔两半约35%的共同信号，两个已发表模型改用重复孔输入后得分下降22-43%，同孔半样本高估可重复性并使5/13块板假阳性。因此此类数据应以孔为实验单位做评测、重复上限和统计检验。
papers.abstract_en: Pooled drug screens treat and sequence dozens of cancer cell lines together in one well. Tahoe-100M, the largest, is used to train and benchmark models that predict how unmeasured cell lines respond to drugs, and its benchmarks, reproducibility ceilings and statistical tests treat the cell lines of a well, and random halves of a well's cells, as independent observations of a drug's effect. Because the drug is applied to the well, this is harmless only if the lines of a well share nothing beyond the drug's reproducible effect. We tested this with pairs of untreated control wells on 13 plates, with replicate wells whose labels we checked, and with two plates that repeat each other well by well. In each test the cell lines of a well share a component of expression that a replicate well does not reproduce, also when the two wells occupy the same inferred position; where drugs are present, it cannot be told apart from an interaction of plate and drug, but in untreated wells it can. In replicate wells at different positions whose labels pass the check, about a third of what two halves of a well have in common (35%, 95% interval 22-58%, 9 compounds) is not reproduced by the replicate well. The well effect inflates results that take something from a well and judge it in the same well: retrained versions of two published models that take a measured response as input lose about a quarter to a third of their score when the input comes from a replicate well instead of the predicted well (22-43% under the control-well reference), halves of a well overstate how well the experiment reproduces, and a test across the lines of a well calls 5 of 13 plates significant when two untreated wells are compared. Many labels of strongly responding replicate wells, those of plate 13 above all, fail the label check. Evaluations, ceilings and tests on such data should treat the well as the experimental unit.
